cohort: The study included 3,049 pregnant women who had vaginal singleton deliveries between January 2019 and September 2022 in two Italian University hospitals, excluding those with cesarean sections, nonvertex presentation, preterm delivery, multiple pregnancies, congenital malformations, or stillbirths.
finding: Asian women in Southern Europe demonstrated a significantly elevated risk for Obstetric Anal Sphincter Injuries (OASIs) with an adjusted OR of 2.540 (p value 0.01).
